title: MH Aesthetic & Beauty Clinic Ltd
ownerDescription:
5 star clinic with 100% 5 star reviews on all platforms. We offer the following treatments - Hydrafacials, Cosmelan, Mesopeels, IPL - Thread vein, pigmentation & hair removal & acne, LVL Lash lift, Fillers, Pro max lipo, RF skin tightening, Dermaplaning, Face peels, medical micro-needling, Gel nails, LED facials, Medik8 facials, waxing, manicures, pedicures, Vajacials, skin consultations.
Clinic Director Maureen Hayden is the most experienced Hydrafacialist in the West Midlands known as 'The Hydrafacial Queen' over 14 years Hydrafacial experience
20 years in the industry. All treatments suitable for all skin types, ethnicites both male & female.
Clinic location in the Royal town of Sutton Coldfield, West Midlands.
address: 34 High St, The Royal Town of Sutton Coldfield, Birmingham, Sutton Coldfield B72 1UP, Inggris Raya
neighborhood: The Royal Town of Sutton Coldfield, Birmingham

reviews.name: Penny Kay
reviews.text: I just wanted to say a massive thank you - my 17 year old son has just come back so positively from his first facial with you. He suffers with his skin and his sister has been coming to you and her skin is looking amazing & she thought he would benefit too. He also has autism & he really got on so well with his therapist. It’s amazing & we will back in 4-6 weeks. Thanks so much!
reviews.textTranslated: Saya hanya ingin mengucapkan terima kasih sebesar-besarnya - putra saya yang berusia 17 tahun baru saja kembali dengan sangat positif setelah perawatan wajah pertamanya di tempat Anda. Dia memiliki masalah kulit dan saudara perempuannya juga datang ke tempat Anda dan kulitnya terlihat luar biasa & dia pikir putranya juga akan mendapatkan manfaatnya. Dia juga mengidap autisme & dia benar-benar cocok dengan terapisnya. Ini luar biasa & kami akan kembali dalam 4-6 minggu. Terima kasih banyak!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much, Penny, for taking the time to share this. I am delighted your son came away feeling so positive after his first facial, and that our therapist helped him feel at ease, especially given his autism. It means a great deal to hear your daughter has seen such wonderful results too, and I look forward to welcoming you back in 4 to 6 weeks.

reviews.name: Kerry Burke
reviews.text:
I absolutely love coming to MH Aesthetic & Beauty Clinic for my hydrafacials. Maureen and Charissa are so welcoming and friendly from the moment I walk through the door. The clinic is always clean and inviting with a relaxing atmosphere.

Maureen will always assess my skin and ask questions prior to any treatment so she can tailor the facial and products used to address any concerns at the time.

I look forward to my visits, whether I want a quiet treatment or a nice chat, I always feel comfortable and look forward to leaving feeling pampered, with exceptionally clean and hydrated skin with a signature glow I have only ever found here.

My skin has greatly improved since starting hydrafacials here and has given me a new found confidence and I now hardly ever wear make up at all.

Thanks so much Maureen and Charissa! I look forward to trying new treatments with you this year!
reviews.textTranslated:
Saya sangat senang datang ke MH Aesthetic & Beauty Clinic untuk perawatan hydrafacial saya. Maureen dan Charissa sangat ramah dan bersahabat sejak saya masuk ke dalam klinik. Klinik selalu bersih dan nyaman dengan suasana yang menenangkan.

Maureen selalu menilai kondisi kulit saya dan mengajukan pertanyaan sebelum perawatan apa pun sehingga ia dapat menyesuaikan perawatan wajah dan produk yang digunakan untuk mengatasi masalah yang ada saat itu.

Saya selalu menantikan kunjungan saya, baik untuk perawatan yang tenang atau sekadar mengobrol santai, saya selalu merasa nyaman dan menantikan untuk pulang dengan perasaan dimanjakan, dengan kulit yang sangat bersih dan terhidrasi serta kilau khas yang hanya saya temukan di sini.

Kulit saya telah jauh lebih baik sejak memulai perawatan hydrafacial di sini dan telah memberi saya kepercayaan diri yang baru, dan sekarang saya hampir tidak pernah memakai riasan sama sekali.

Terima kasih banyak Maureen dan Charissa! Saya menantikan untuk mencoba perawatan baru bersama Anda tahun ini!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear kerry, Thank you for sharing such a wonderful review of your experience having treatments with us in clinic. Its been wonderful to see how your skin and confidence has improved since you first started coming to us. Thank you for trusting us with your skin journey. Keep shining and look forward to seeing you again soon for your monthly Hydrafacials, Microneedling & LVL lash lift.

reviews.name: Caroline Hope
reviews.text: There are no words to describe how amazing MH Aesthetic & Beauty is. I started seeing Maureen many years ago, because she was known as the Hydrafacial Queen, and her salon quickly became a huge part of my life. It's a sanctuary of peace, calm and impeccable professionalism, which reflects Maureen herself as a person. Supporting all skin types and ethnicities, she'll help you to achieve gorgeous, glowing skin; and if you need any further incentive, pop in and look at Maureen's skin!! This salon is one in a million, just like its owner x
reviews.textTranslated: Tidak ada kata-kata yang dapat menggambarkan betapa menakjubkannya MH Aesthetic & Beauty. Saya mulai mengunjungi Maureen bertahun-tahun yang lalu, karena dia dikenal sebagai Ratu Hydrafacial, dan salonnya dengan cepat menjadi bagian besar dari hidup saya. Ini adalah tempat yang damai, tenang, dan profesional, yang mencerminkan Maureen sebagai pribadi. Mendukung semua jenis kulit dan etnis, dia akan membantu Anda mendapatkan kulit yang cantik dan bercahaya; dan jika Anda membutuhkan insentif lebih lanjut, mampir dan lihat kulit Maureen!! Salon ini adalah satu dari sejuta, seperti pemiliknya x
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Caroline, thank you so much, those words and what you have said mean so much. So happy to read how much you enjoy coming into clinic and  the calm space created. We enjoy treating you each and every time you come in and your skin too is evidence of your continued dedication. Look forward to seeing you soon. Take care x

reviews.name: Afshan Sheikh
reviews.text: I can’t speak highly enough of MH Aesthetic & Beauty Clinic. I have been coming here for years and I've always had the most wonderful experience. I have regular hydrafacial, dermaplanning & microneedling sessions and Maureen & Clarissa always go above and beyond. The service, care and attention to detail they provide is second to none, not to mention the glow I have when I leave the clinic! I wouldn't go anywhere else, they truly care about delivering top notch results. I highly recommend.
reviews.textTranslated: Saya sangat merekomendasikan MH Aesthetic & Beauty Clinic. Saya sudah bertahun-tahun datang ke sini dan selalu mendapatkan pengalaman yang luar biasa. Saya rutin melakukan perawatan hydrafacial, dermaplanning & microneedling, dan Maureen & Clarissa selalu memberikan pelayanan terbaik. Layanan, perawatan, dan perhatian terhadap detail yang mereka berikan tiada duanya, belum lagi kilau yang saya dapatkan setelah keluar dari klinik! Saya tidak akan pergi ke tempat lain, mereka benar-benar peduli untuk memberikan hasil terbaik. Saya sangat merekomendasikan tempat ini.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Afshan, Thank you for taking the time to share your personal experience, we really appreciate it. Thank you for continuing to trust us with your already beautiful skin and look forward to treating you again soon.

reviews.name: Nneka Obisi
reviews.text:
Have been using MH Aesthetics for nearly a year and I have seen massive  differences in my skin texture and appearance and the glow up is real
I had concerns with hyperpigmentation and uneven dull skin but Maureen listened attentively to my concerns ,recommended tailored treatment based on my concerns and that has worked out brilliantly

My skins hyperpigmentation is fully cleared ,she did recommend skin ingredients which I needed to incorporate into my routine and that worked like magic!
Maureen is a true professional with a wealth of knowledge and I have been a repeat happy customer  since then
reviews.textTranslated:
Saya telah menggunakan MH Aesthetics selama hampir setahun dan saya telah melihat perbedaan besar pada tekstur dan penampilan kulit saya, dan perubahannya sangat nyata.
Saya memiliki kekhawatiran tentang hiperpigmentasi dan kulit kusam yang tidak merata, tetapi Maureen mendengarkan kekhawatiran saya dengan saksama, merekomendasikan perawatan yang disesuaikan berdasarkan kekhawatiran saya, dan itu berhasil dengan sangat baik.

Hiperpigmentasi kulit saya benar-benar hilang, dia merekomendasikan bahan-bahan perawatan kulit yang perlu saya masukkan ke dalam rutinitas saya dan itu bekerja seperti sihir!
Maureen adalah seorang profesional sejati dengan banyak pengetahuan dan saya telah menjadi pelanggan setia yang puas sejak saat itu.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Dear Nneka, thank you for leaving such a kind review really appreciate it. Its been wonderful to see how far your skin has come over the last year and how well it is being maintained. Look forwrd to seeing you again very soon. Take care.

reviews.name: Caitlin Beales
reviews.text: I went to Maureen for a skin consultation as I've been really struggling with my skin. She was honestly so lovely and helpful and gave me some great advice! My worry was feeling pressured into spending money on loads of expensive products or treatments, but she wasn't pushy at all. She made me feel so comfortable and I would highly recommend her to anyone :)
reviews.textTranslated: Saya pergi ke Maureen untuk konsultasi kulit karena saya benar-benar kesulitan dengan kulit saya. Dia benar-benar sangat ramah dan membantu, serta memberi saya beberapa saran yang bagus! Kekhawatiran saya adalah merasa tertekan untuk menghabiskan banyak uang untuk produk atau perawatan mahal, tetapi dia sama sekali tidak memaksa. Dia membuat saya merasa sangat nyaman dan saya sangat merekomendasikannya kepada siapa pun :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Caitlin it was lovely to meet you in consultation and so happy you choose to come to us for your skin health journey. Look forward to seeing you very soon. Take care.

reviews.name: Moyo Bajomo
reviews.text: Friendly, supportive, and welcoming team . Highly recommend!
reviews.textTranslated: Tim yang ramah, suportif, dan hangat. Sangat direkomendasikan!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much Moyo, we appreciate you sharing your experience. Look forward to seeing you in clinic soon.

reviews.name: Lubna Khan
reviews.text:
Maureen is absolutely amazing. I go to her for Hydrafacial and microneedling, and she truly has magic hands. She takes the time to understand my skin and always adjusts the treatment based on what my skin needs at that moment. The results speak for themselves—my skin looks healthier, smoother, and more balanced every time. You can really tell she cares about delivering the best results, not just doing a routine treatment. Highly recommend her. Thank you Maureen.

Lubna khan
reviews.textTranslated:
Maureen benar-benar luar biasa. Saya pergi kepadanya untuk perawatan Hydrafacial dan microneedling, dan dia benar-benar memiliki tangan ajaib. Dia meluangkan waktu untuk memahami kulit saya dan selalu menyesuaikan perawatan berdasarkan apa yang dibutuhkan kulit saya saat itu. Hasilnya berbicara sendiri—kulit saya terlihat lebih sehat, lebih halus, dan lebih seimbang setiap kali. Anda benar-benar dapat melihat bahwa dia peduli untuk memberikan hasil terbaik, bukan hanya melakukan perawatan rutin. Sangat merekomendasikannya. Terima kasih Maureen.

Lubna Khan
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Lubna, we really appreciate you taking the time to leave this very kind review and lovely to hear how happy you are having treatments here in clinic with us. Its been wonderful to see the progress in your skin health over time. Look forward to seeing you very soon. Maureen

reviews.name: Aisha Ramzan
reviews.text: The best facial ever with Maureen. She was so comforting and just such a lovely person. Made my skin GLOW before my wedding and it was just honestly so relaxing I fell asleep and I’m not usually someone to let go like that, but that’s just Maureen’s touch!! You won’t regret any money spent here or truly is an investment you will WILL say it’s worth it!
reviews.textTranslated: Perawatan wajah terbaik yang pernah saya alami bersama Maureen. Dia sangat menenangkan dan benar-benar orang yang menyenangkan. Membuat kulit saya BERSINAR sebelum pernikahan saya dan jujur ​​saja, perawatannya sangat menenangkan sampai saya tertidur, padahal biasanya saya bukan tipe orang yang mudah terbuai seperti itu, tapi itu berkat sentuhan Maureen!! Anda tidak akan menyesal mengeluarkan uang di sini, ini benar-benar investasi yang PASTI akan Anda akui sepadan!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Was a absolute pleasure being a part of your skin preperation leading up to your very special wedding day. Thank you for choosing us and look forward to seeing you again soon. Keep glowing. Maureen

reviews.name: Andrea W
reviews.text: I had my first hydrafacial last week. Maureen explained everything and made the whole experience very relaxing. My skin looks so much better. I’ve already booked my next one!
reviews.textTranslated: Saya menjalani perawatan hydrafacial pertama saya minggu lalu. Maureen menjelaskan semuanya dan membuat seluruh pengalaman sangat menenangkan. Kulit saya terlihat jauh lebih baik. Saya sudah memesan perawatan selanjutnya!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Andrea for taking the time to share such a positive experience and review, we really appreciate it and look forward to treating you again very soon. Thank you again. Maureen

reviews.name: Lucy Harris
reviews.text: I have now been coming for a few months and the facials from Maureen and Charissa have been amazing. My sensitive , eczema prone skin has been looked after so well and has never been in such good condition. Wish I had discovered them earlier!
reviews.textTranslated: Saya sudah datang ke sini selama beberapa bulan dan perawatan wajah dari Maureen dan Charissa sangat luar biasa. Kulit saya yang sensitif dan rentan eksim dirawat dengan sangat baik dan belum pernah dalam kondisi sebaik ini. Saya berharap saya menemukan mereka lebih awal!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your kind comments Lucy, been a pleasure treating your skin leading up to your special day. Look forward to treating you again soon. Take care x

reviews.name: Taiya Fadare
reviews.text: Charissa is amazing 🫶🏾
reviews.textTranslated: Charissa luar biasa 🫶🏾
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for taking the time to share your experience following treatment with Aesthetician Charissa. Look forward to seeing you soon.

reviews.name: Kristal K
reviews.text: I booked a skin consultation and eyelash tint.  The service I received from Charissa was professional, friendly and knowledgeable.  I had great results from my lash tint.  During the skin consultation Charissa listened and provided great advice and guidance for my skincare routine.  I was recommended some products to try and also a Medik 8 facial that I've booked for December... looking forward to it!  Thanks for such a great experience, I would highly recommend MH Aesthetic & Beauty Clinic.  Parking available a short walk away too.
reviews.textTranslated: Saya memesan konsultasi kulit dan pewarnaan bulu mata. Pelayanan yang saya terima dari Charissa sangat profesional, ramah, dan berpengetahuan luas. Saya mendapatkan hasil yang bagus dari pewarnaan bulu mata saya. Selama konsultasi kulit, Charissa mendengarkan dan memberikan saran serta panduan yang bagus untuk rutinitas perawatan kulit saya. Saya direkomendasikan beberapa produk untuk dicoba dan juga perawatan wajah Medik 8 yang telah saya pesan untuk bulan Desember... saya sangat menantikannya! Terima kasih atas pengalaman yang luar biasa ini, saya sangat merekomendasikan MH Aesthetic & Beauty Clinic. Tersedia tempat parkir yang berjarak tidak jauh.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Kristal for taking the time to share your experience we really appreciate it. We look forward to treating you for your facial and will pass on your kind comments to Charissa.

reviews.name: Jay Swan
reviews.text: What can I say. I have just been to MH Aesthetic & Beauty Clinic and experienced a Platinum Hydrafacial with booster. The facial was amazing and my skin is glowing. If you are looking for a treatment where you will see instant results, this is the treatment you need. Maureen is attentive and knowledgable and she showed me so much care and attention. If you are thinking about it just do it. it's worth it. I will be back.
reviews.textTranslated: Apa yang bisa saya katakan? Saya baru saja mengunjungi MH Aesthetic & Beauty Clinic dan mencoba perawatan Platinum Hydrafacial dengan booster. Perawatan wajahnya luar biasa dan kulit saya tampak bercahaya. Jika Anda mencari perawatan yang memberikan hasil instan, inilah perawatan yang Anda butuhkan. Maureen sangat perhatian dan berpengetahuan luas, dan dia menunjukkan begitu banyak kepedulian dan perhatian kepada saya. Jika Anda masih ragu, lakukan saja. Ini sangat berharga. Saya akan kembali lagi.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Jay, for such a kind review. I am delighted you loved the Platinum Hydrafacial with booster and left with that instant glow you were hoping for, and it means a great deal to hear you felt well cared for throughout. I truly look forward to welcoming you back to MH Aesthetic and Beauty Clinic Ltd.

reviews.name: Linda Francis
reviews.text:
Today I had a RF skin tightening and Medik8 facial and it was the best facial I have ever had in my life. The atmosphere was very relaxing, the therapist Marietta
was very welcoming and she did an amazing job. I was so relaxed that I almost fell asleep. I have never felt like this during a facial before but I was truly fighting sleep today. The massage was great, and the equipment used to do the skin tightening added to the relaxation.
I cannot recommend this facial enough. I felt great afterwards and my skin was glowing.
Try this and see for yourself, you will not be disappointed. This is the best facial ever!
I usually don't write reviews  but I was very impressed with the level of service and the experience and wanted to say thanks for making this experience something to shout about. Thanks Maureen and Marietta.
reviews.textTranslated:
Hari ini saya menjalani perawatan pengencangan kulit RF dan facial Medik8, dan itu adalah facial terbaik yang pernah saya alami seumur hidup. Suasananya sangat menenangkan, terapis Marietta sangat ramah dan dia melakukan pekerjaan yang luar biasa. Saya sangat rileks hingga hampir tertidur. Saya belum pernah merasa seperti ini selama facial sebelumnya, tetapi hari ini saya benar-benar berjuang melawan rasa kantuk. Pijatannya luar biasa, dan peralatan yang digunakan untuk mengencangkan kulit menambah relaksasi.
Saya sangat merekomendasikan facial ini. Saya merasa hebat setelahnya dan kulit saya bersinar.
Cobalah dan buktikan sendiri, Anda tidak akan kecewa. Ini adalah facial terbaik yang pernah ada!
Saya biasanya tidak menulis ulasan, tetapi saya sangat terkesan dengan tingkat layanan dan pengalamannya, dan ingin mengucapkan terima kasih karena telah membuat pengalaman ini menjadi sesuatu yang patut dibanggakan. Terima kasih Maureen dan Marietta.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Linda, for such a generous review. I am delighted you enjoyed the RF skin tightening and Medik8 facial, and that Marietta’s warm welcome, the relaxing atmosphere, massage, and equipment left you so comfortable you nearly drifted off, with glowing skin afterwards. We truly appreciate you taking the time to share this, and we will be sure to pass your kind words on to Marietta.

reviews.name: A Webb
reviews.text: I am so glad I discovered MH Aesthetic and beauty clinic! I’ve had Hydrafacial’s, laser treatments, Medik8 treatments and foot treatments and all have been to the highest standard and quality, not only that, the wonderful ladies that have treatment me, Marietta, Clarissa, and Clinic owner Maureen, have been professional, friendly and so knowledgeable. I couldn’t recommend enough!
reviews.textTranslated: Saya sangat senang telah menemukan klinik estetika dan kecantikan MH! Saya sudah menjalani perawatan Hydrafacial, perawatan laser, perawatan Medik8, dan perawatan kaki, dan semuanya dilakukan dengan standar dan kualitas terbaik. Tidak hanya itu, para wanita luar biasa yang merawat saya, Marietta, Clarissa, dan pemilik klinik Maureen, sangat profesional, ramah, dan berpengetahuan luas. Saya sangat merekomendasikannya!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Hi Alicia, thank you so much for your kind words and so very pleased you are continuing to enjoy all of the treatments and services with us in clinic. Its a pleasure to treat you on every visit and appreciate you taking the time to share your experience. Thank you again and look forward to welcoming you in again very soon. Take care
Maureen x

reviews.name: Toni Delaney
reviews.text: First time hydrofacial, treated by my sister in law. It is fabulous. My skin has never looked cleaner, and actually hydrated. I have very sensitive skin, and yjis was amazing.
reviews.textTranslated: Ini pertama kalinya saya mencoba hydrofacial, dan dirawat oleh saudara ipar saya. Hasilnya luar biasa. Kulit saya belum pernah terlihat sebersih ini, dan benar-benar terhidrasi. Kulit saya sangat sensitif, dan perawatan ini sangat menakjubkan.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Toni, for sharing your experience with your first hydrofacial. I am delighted to hear your skin felt noticeably cleaner and properly hydrated, especially given how sensitive it is, and I am so pleased the treatment suited you so well.

reviews.name: Madiha Ahmed
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you, Madiha, for the 5 star rating and for choosing MH Aesthetic & Beauty Clinic Ltd for your skincare. We truly appreciate your support and look forward to welcoming you back whenever you next need us.

reviews.name: K Kaur
reviews.text: I have been coming to this clinic for 2 years and I don't think I will stop coming. The treatments and variety are amazing and staff knowledge and care is of high quality. Its the perfect time out and self care I need and I would 100% recommend to anyone!
reviews.textTranslated: Saya sudah datang ke klinik ini selama 2 tahun dan saya rasa saya tidak akan berhenti datang. Perawatan dan variasi yang ditawarkan sangat luar biasa, dan pengetahuan serta pelayanan stafnya berkualitas tinggi. Ini adalah waktu istirahat dan perawatan diri yang sempurna yang saya butuhkan, dan saya akan merekomendasikannya 100% kepada siapa pun!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for leaving such kind words and recommending or service. We Look forward to treating you again soon.

reviews.name: Päivi Uotinen
reviews.text:
I have been having hydrafacials regularly for a while now and this has definitely helped to improve my skin, and been a big help in controlling hormonal blemishes I am prone to. Charissa is very professional and friendly, and I enjoy our chats during my facial. She knows what my skin needs; I always feel relaxed and my skin feels so much better afterwards.
I can highly recommend MH Aesthetic & Beauty Clinic 👍
reviews.textTranslated:
Saya sudah rutin melakukan perawatan hydrafacial selama beberapa waktu dan ini benar-benar membantu memperbaiki kulit saya, serta sangat membantu dalam mengendalikan jerawat hormonal yang sering saya alami. Charissa sangat profesional dan ramah, dan saya menikmati obrolan kami selama perawatan wajah. Dia tahu apa yang dibutuhkan kulit saya; saya selalu merasa rileks dan kulit saya terasa jauh lebih baik setelahnya.
Saya sangat merekomendasikan MH Aesthetic & Beauty Clinic 👍
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Paivi for taking the time to share your personal experience. We will of course let Charissa know how pleased you have been throughout your skin journey. Look forward to treating you again very soon.

reviews.name: molly agg
reviews.text: Amazing hydrofacial with Charissa fantastic advise too I would come back
reviews.textTranslated: Perawatan hydrofacial yang luar biasa dengan Charissa, saran yang fantastis juga, saya pasti akan kembali.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for sharing your experience Molly, will be sure to let Charissa know how happy you are following Hydrafacial.  We look forward to seeing you again in clinic soon.

reviews.name: Harriet Clarke
reviews.text: I booked a skin consultation with Marietta in March when my skin was completely freaking out and was unsure what to expect. She recommended that I have IPL for acne and the changes in my skin have been amazing. I’m so glad I booked my first consultation and would highly recommend the clinic. Everyone is so professional and it’s a really lovely place to go for treatments. Thanks Marietta! 😊
reviews.textTranslated: Saya memesan konsultasi kulit dengan Marietta pada bulan Maret ketika kulit saya benar-benar bermasalah dan saya tidak yakin apa yang akan terjadi. Dia merekomendasikan perawatan IPL untuk jerawat dan perubahan pada kulit saya sangat luar biasa. Saya sangat senang telah memesan konsultasi pertama saya dan sangat merekomendasikan klinik ini. Semua orang sangat profesional dan tempatnya sangat nyaman untuk perawatan. Terima kasih Marietta! 😊
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Harriet for taking the time to share your positive experience. We are so happy to hear you are experiencing great results and seeing changes with your skin. Will pass on your kind comments to Marietta. Thank you once again and look forward to seeing you soon.

reviews.name: Sonia Valcarreres
reviews.text:
Fab facial with Charissa.
After my first facial I booked a course of 6.
My skin is glowing.
Charissa understands my skin needs and she has been outstanding looking after me.
Definitely recommended
reviews.textTranslated:
Facial yang luar biasa dengan Charissa.
Setelah facial pertama saya, saya memesan paket 6 kali perawatan.
Kulit saya bersinar.
Charissa memahami kebutuhan kulit saya dan dia sangat luar biasa dalam merawat saya.
Sangat direkomendasikan.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Sonia, its a pleasure treating you and so glad to hear how happy you have been having treatments with us. We look forward to welcoming you into clinic again soon.

reviews.name: La-chaunte Smith
reviews.text: Always amazing results when I visit this clinic my skin has never looked or felt so good 🫶🏾
reviews.textTranslated: Selalu hasil yang menakjubkan setiap kali saya mengunjungi klinik ini, kulit saya belum pernah terlihat atau terasa sebaik ini 🫶🏾
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Always a pleasure to treat you too, thank you for choosing us and look forward to welcoming you into clinic soon.

reviews.name: Ellie C
reviews.text: My facial was so relaxing and my skin has never been this clean, smooth & glowing. I felt at ease throughout.
reviews.textTranslated: Perawatan wajah saya sangat menenangkan dan kulit saya belum pernah sebersih, sehalus, dan secerah ini. Saya merasa nyaman sepanjang perawatan.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you for sharing your personal experience Ellie, we really appreciate it. Will see you again soon, take care.

reviews.name: aleksandra pechotina
reviews.text: Marietta took the Medik8 facial to a new level and made my skin (and me) feel amazing. Thank you!
reviews.textTranslated: Marietta membawa perawatan wajah Medik8 ke level yang baru dan membuat kulit saya (dan saya) merasa luar biasa. Terima kasih!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: We are so pleased to hear this and thank you for taking the time to share your positive experience. We look forward to welcoming you into clinic again soon. Thank you x

reviews.name: charan kaur
reviews.text: Fantastic service and wonderful facial. Could not recommend more highly enough. Than you!!
reviews.textTranslated: Pelayanan fantastis dan perawatan wajah yang luar biasa. Sangat direkomendasikan. Terima kasih!!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Its our pleasure, thank you so much for letting us know about your experience, we really appreciate it. Look forward to welcoming you into clinic again soon.

reviews.name: Jess
reviews.text: I had my consultation with Charissa and had a Hydrafacial. It was a lovely experience, professional but yet light-hearted friendly environment. Charissa answered all my questions and addressed my skin concerns. Thank you!
reviews.textTranslated: Saya telah berkonsultasi dengan Charissa dan melakukan perawatan Hydrafacial. Itu adalah pengalaman yang menyenangkan, profesional namun tetap ramah dan santai. Charissa menjawab semua pertanyaan saya dan mengatasi masalah kulit saya. Terima kasih!
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you Jess for leaving this lovely review, we will be sure to let Charissa know of your kinds words.  Look forward to welcoming you into clinic again soon.

reviews.name: Kristy Littlewood
reviews.text: I had my first consultation with Maureen just over a year ago, where Maureen listened carefully to my skin concerns and provided expert advice. I have continued a skin care routine and hydra-facials with Maureen and Marietta and I could not be happier with the results! I noticed immediate improvements after the first hydra-facial and I receive continuous compliments on my skin since starting my skin care routine. Both Maureen and Marietta are professional yet friendly and I feel super comfortable and welcome at each and every session. I could not recommend enough - best thing I did for my skin :)
reviews.textTranslated: Saya melakukan konsultasi pertama saya dengan Maureen lebih dari setahun yang lalu, di mana Maureen mendengarkan dengan saksama masalah kulit saya dan memberikan saran ahli. Saya terus melakukan perawatan kulit dan hydra-facial dengan Maureen dan Marietta dan saya sangat senang dengan hasilnya! Saya melihat peningkatan langsung setelah hydra-facial pertama dan saya terus menerima pujian tentang kulit saya sejak memulai rutinitas perawatan kulit saya. Baik Maureen maupun Marietta profesional namun ramah dan saya merasa sangat nyaman dan disambut di setiap sesi. Saya sangat merekomendasikannya - hal terbaik yang saya lakukan untuk kulit saya :)
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: So heart warming to read of your experience kristy. Its been wonderful to see how your skin journey has developed over the last year and so pleased to hear of your positive experience with us. Thank you for trusting us with your skin and for taking the time to share you, we really appreciate it. Look forward to welcoming you into clinic soon x

reviews.name: Eve Barron
reviews.text: Went for my regular wax with the lovely Charissa, i was very anxious my first time but she absolutely put me at ease, is so kind and professional. An absolute star, cannot recommend enough.
reviews.textTranslated: Saya melakukan waxing rutin dengan Charissa yang ramah. Awalnya saya sangat cemas, tetapi dia benar-benar membuat saya nyaman, sangat baik dan profesional. Benar-benar luar biasa, sangat saya rekomendasikan.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText: Thank you so much for taking the time to share you experience with us, we will pass on your kind words to Charissa and thank you for choosing to come to our clinic for your beauty treatments. See you again soon.
